items.scope: All four October 20 DOCX/PDF originals were supplied, read, hashed and reconciled before final reporting. The earlier unavailable finding is superseded; source chronology and substantive corrections are documented in SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md.

46 retained legacy Learn/Meditation Article nodes still lack a verified publication or material-update date. Git timestamps alone are not publication proof. Eleven materially updated Article pages received truthful visible modification dates; no dates were fabricated.

The original October 26 window was intervened. The revised 28-day window and finalization lag must pass before outcome comparisons or future consolidation decisions. Scheduled collection is configured; future collection is not marked completed.
No authenticated, authorized named monastic, scholarly, clinical or external expert review is available. Organizational editorial responsibility and existing review boundaries remain explicit.

Existing Wrangler OAuth can read/deploy the Worker and custom domain. Zone settings, DNS, rulesets and Bot Management endpoints returned HTTP 403. Available dashboard controls were inspected; no broader credential access was created.

Cloudflare classifies Claude-User as an AI Crawler and displays its block switch checked and disabled. Major search/AI-search controls are allowed. No unsupported individual override or broad security relaxation was performed.

Bing authenticated JSON endpoints were verified using an existing credential and integrated into the weekly workflow. GA4 is verified through its authenticated dashboard; a GA4 unattended account API collector is not configured. Hosted Bing workflow verification is recorded in the final deployment report.
Lighthouse results are lab samples. No real-user CrUX/Core Web Vitals improvement or Google ranking/indexing/AdSense outcome is asserted.
